description:
Strict board graphics, text, tracks, vias, tables, dimensions, authored
zone fills, and embedded footprints subset of kicad.plotter_ir.a0. Producers
and consumers must run generated semantic validation after structural decoding.
title: Board plot document a0

PlotterCoordinateSpace.description: Coordinate convention for the footprint plotter slice.

JavaScriptSafeInteger.description: Integer that remains exact when decoded as a JavaScript number.

BoardGraphicPlotRecord.description:
One board-level graphic record. The carrier layer travels on the record;
the contained operations are layerless graphic-state operations.

TrackSegmentPlotRecord.description: One board track segment record with its net attribution.

TrackArcPlotRecord.description: One board track arc record with its net attribution.

ViaPlotRecord.description:
One board via record: copper aperture, synthetic drill, and per-side mask
opening/drill pairs when tenting explicitly exposes that side. IPC-4761
fabrication metadata mirrors the established stringified booleans.

TablePlotRecord.description: Board table grid/border segments followed by optional faced cell text.

DimensionPlotRecord.description: Dimension text (when present) followed by layered construction geometry.

ZoneFillPlotRecord.description:
One zone fill record bundling every `filled_polygon` ring. The parallel
`fill_layers`/`fill_island` arrays annotate the rings so consumers can
split or colour-key without re-walking the source zone.

BoardTextPlotRecord.description:
One board free-text record. `hide` mirrors the established serializer's
getattr default and is always false for board gr_text carriers.

BoardTextBoxPlotRecord.description:
One board text-box record. A visible border contributes a leading Rect
operation; empty resolved text drops the Text operation.

BoardFootprintPlotRecord.description: One board-embedded footprint in canonical child and pad-block order.

BoardGraphicRecordKind.description: Board graphic record kinds promoted in the first board slice.

PlotterOperation.description: Shared plotter operation vocabulary promoted across source producers.

BoardViaType.description: Via construction kinds mirrored from the established producer.

PlotterStringBool.description: Stringified boolean metadata mirrored from the established producer.

BoardDimensionType.description: Board dimension construction styles supported by KiCad's PCB plotter.

BoardFootprintOperation.description: Strict operation vocabulary for one board-embedded footprint record.

BoardFootprintPlacement.description: Footprint-local placement applied by board renderers.

ThickSegmentOperation.description:
Solid or decomposed segment shared by PCB, footprint, and drill producers.
Graphic state requires only layer. Drill state requires role plus layers;
NPTH drill state additionally requires all mask and pad-size hints. The
generated semantic validator enforces these mutually exclusive states.

CircleOperation.description:
Circle shared by graphical and drill producers. Graphic state requires only
layer. Drill state requires role plus layers; NPTH state additionally
requires all mask and pad-size hints. The generated semantic validator
enforces these mutually exclusive states.

BezierCurveOperation.description: Cubic Bézier shared by symbol and schematic producers.

TextOperation.description:
Stroke or cached text operation. Boolean marker keys (`mirror`,
`text_as_polygons`, `polyline_per_segment`, `knockout`) are present-only
-when-true, matching the established Python emitter. Render-cache keys
appear together when an authored cache resolves; `render_cache_polygons`
carries the exterior rings in nanometres.

FlashPadCircleOperation.description:
Circular pad flash shared by footprint and PCB producers. Footprint pad
state requires mask_margin_nm and forbids role. Board via state requires
role and forbids mask_margin_nm. The generated semantic validator enforces
these mutually exclusive states.

FlashPadOvalOperation.description: Oval pad flash shared by footprint and PCB producers.

FlashPadRectOperation.description: Rectangular pad flash shared by footprint and PCB producers.

FlashPadRoundRectOperation.description: Rounded-rectangle pad flash shared by footprint and PCB producers.

FlashPadCustomOperation.description:
Custom pad flash shared by footprint and PCB producers. Polygon coordinates
are pad-local. A non-empty polygon_widths_nm has one entry per polygon;
generated semantic validation enforces that relationship. An empty array is
equivalent to omission for generated Rust transport bindings.

FlashPadTrapezOperation.description: Trapezoid pad flash shared by footprint and PCB producers.

BoardFootprintStartBlockOperation.description: Opening operation for one embedded pad or drill SVG group.

BoardFootprintEndBlockOperation.description: Closing operation for one embedded pad or drill SVG group.

PlotterDrillRole.description: Semantic roles allowed on shared circle and segment drill operations.

PlotterFill.description: Fill values shared by plotter operation producers.

PlotterLineStyle.description: KiCad stroke styles carried without producer-specific decomposition.

PlotterPoint.description: Plotter point encoded as an exact coordinate pair.

PlotterTextHAlign.description: Horizontal text alignments emitted by the board producers.

PlotterTextVAlign.description: Vertical text alignments emitted by the board producers.

TextRenderCache.description:
Typed render cache from an authored `(render_cache ...)` form, the Python
resolver, or the deterministic native hinted outline engine. `knockout` appears when the
knockout background restructure replaced the polygons.

PlotterTextRenderCacheSource.description: Provenance of one attached text render cache.

PlotterViaFlashRole.description: Semantic roles allowed on board via flash operations.

BoardFootprintChildRef.description: Source child kinds emitted directly on embedded-footprint drawing operations.

BoardFootprintChildAttrs.description: SVG-enrichment metadata retained on one embedded-footprint child operation.

BoardFootprintPadBlockAttrs.description: Stringified SVG-enrichment attributes on an embedded pad block.

PlotterTextRenderCacheCoordinateSpace.description: Coordinate space carried by one typed text render cache.

TextRenderCachePolygon.description: One render-cache polygon as ordered contours, exterior ring first.

BoardFootprintLayerRole.description: Normalized PCB layer roles mirrored by enriched footprint-child metadata.
